points.text: Rearranges Ohm's law to I = V / R before substituting
Gives the current as 3 A from 12 / 4

items.prompt: A 12 V battery is connected across a resistor of 4 ohms. Calculate the current, showing the Ohm's law step.

points.text: States the second ammeter also reads 0.5 A
Explains that current is the same all around a series loop and is not used up by the bulb

items.prompt: An ammeter reads 0.5 A just before a bulb in a series circuit. What does an ammeter just after the bulb read, and why?

points.text: Writes work done as force times distance, 50 x 4
Gives the work done as 200 J

items.prompt: A force of 50 N pushes a crate 4 m in the direction of the force. How much work is done?

points.text: Writes power as work done over time, 200 / 2

items.prompt: The 200 J of work from the crate push is done in 2 s. Calculate the power.
